processing: Retarget to existing MakeHuman MPFB skeleton
Remove horizontal root displacement and heading into mocap-contract.json
Preserve recorded vertical body and limb timing
Normalize loop endpoint residual; shoe support height correction
CMU does not capture fingers: manually posed relaxed fingers, forearm-following wrists
limitations: Recorded performer is not Cristiano Ronaldo; these are generic human motions.
CMU early captures may contain marker noise; fingers are not captured.
Dive and Fall retained from previous prototype only for role compatibility.
No new facial capture or scanned face included.
